name: App Icon: FLUX Slashed Koban Fortune
purpose: Primary App Icon — FLUX.1 [schnell] Samurai Money Fusion.
description: Pure solid black samurai blade cleaving a traditional Japanese Koban gold currency coin in half inside a solid flat red sun disc.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game app icon representing samurai wealth. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai katana blade slicing a traditional oval Japanese Koban wealth coin in half. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only. Crisp clean vector geometry, no 3D rendering, no human face, no text, no watermark.
